questions.text: (14) د لاندیني ورکړي شوي انګرٻزي عبارت پھ معیاري پښتو کښې ترجمھ اوکړئ ـ (a) Bayazid Ansari is one of those historical, religious, literary and political figures who influenced the whole life of the Pashtoons. He brought about cultural, religious and political revolution in Pashtoon Society. He got together the scattered tribes of the Pashtoons around him, and organized them in a way to have adopted the form of a movement, which is known as the Rowshani Movement in the history of the Pashtoons. This movement was a religious – cum political movement in his life and was changed into a purely political movement after his death till it eventually died out after Abdul Qadir, son of Ahdad, joined Mughals. Both the line if the verse should be equally metered and equipped with proper fine words, rhythm, rhyms, weighed, syllables and proper length. Moreover poetry consists of many kinds , for example: Qasida, Ghazal, Rubaie, Qitaa, Mukhammas and Musaddas. Poetry contains many aspects and characteristics. Proper poetry is that which is produced by a wise man. A stupid man’s poetry is of no use. The difference between these two kinds of versification is that one of it is a braying of donkey and other is a sweet music. The book was called “Man and God”. It was a unique book in the sense that for the first time Pashto literature saw the publication of letters by two eminent writers on some very deep and enduring philosophical questions. The book contains some fifteen letters, seven by Jafar Achakzai and eight by Hamza Shinwari.
